messages:
jamal: Quick heads-up — saw a bunch of requests with no X-API-Version reaching the routing layer. Console counts them as v2 and it's inflating v2 deprec telemetry.

dev-bot: alert: route=api-gen service=router sample_rate=0.05 missing_header=X-API-Version count=237 :rotating_light:

anya: repro steps?

jamal: curl example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
(note: client omitted X-API-Version)

mike: ah ok. router infers version by endpoint fallback -> maps to v2 for some legacy tokens. That explains console attribution. :eyes:

sara: do we bill against v2 quota then? that'd surprise customers on deprec notice.

leah: if console shows v2, billing likely unaffected (backend billing tags on token) but deprec banners/telemetry might be wrong. need confirm.

console-svc: flagged. We can add an 'inferred_version' column in the dashboard and a 'header_missing' tag in telemetry. Feature flag: `deprec_infer_tag_v1`.

jamal: proposal: (1) mark telemetry events with header_present boolean, (2) run a backfill to recompute deprec counts for last 7d, (3) push console copy: "inferred version" tooltip + canary 5%.

anya: +1 to header_present. Also suggest we respect `X-Client` to avoid mis-inference for old SDKs.

mike: will wire a short fix: router emits header_present=false and inferred_version=v2. ETA EOD.

sara: ops: add a soft alert if deprec-banner impressions >2x expected due to missing headers.

leah: billing confirmed: billing uses token->billing_plan mapping, not version. but we'll need to notify accounts team.

jamal: followups: who owns backfill? console team owns view + tooltip, infra owns event tag, eng-platform to coordinate rollout.

console-svc: created flag `console.infer_header_tagging` -> defaults off. will open PR for dashboard copy.

dev-bot: deploy queued: infra/tagging/7060707099 -> staging

anya: thanks. putting a short runbook: if customers ping "why am I seeing v2 banner?" -> check header_present metric and token map. I'll draft a KB.

mike: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pull/1483

jamal: TY all. will monitor for next 48h. :thumbsup:
